findings.title: push leaves the database with no active (and a discarded pending/encrypting) EQL configuration when the INSERT fails
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Confirmed non-transactional UPDATE without WHERE followed by INSERT in push.ts, which also deactivates pending/encrypting rows.

findings.title: push always fails for schemas with number, bigint or json columns because stack's cast_as values are rejected by the EQL CHECK constraint
findings.label: valid
findings.note: stack emits cast_as 'number'/'bigint'/'json' (schema/index.ts:26,172,341) and EQL's config_check_cast rejects them (sql:3604-3608), so the newly added push would fail for those schemas.

findings.title: install executes an unpinned, unverified 'latest' EQL SQL bundle against customer databases
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same unpinned releases/latest download confirmed in installer and drizzle path; executed without integrity or version check.

findings.title: --supabase grants ALL on the eql_v2 schema and future objects to the anon role
findings.label: valid
findings.note: grantSupabasePermissions (installer/index.ts:229-238) grants ALL on eql_v2 objects and default privileges to anon, as claimed.

findings.title: Experimental changesets option can stop peer-dependent packages from being re-released alongside their peers
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The PR adds the experimental onlyUpdatePeerDependentsWhenOutOfRange option to .changeset/config.json, which can skip peer-dependent releases.
